title: File System & Notes App
description: Work with the fs module to read, write, append, delete and copy files, then build a simple command-line notes app.
objective: Use Node.js file-system APIs for synchronous, asynchronous and Promise-based file operations.
theory: The fs module provides APIs for interacting with files. This lab compares synchronous and asynchronous reading and uses callbacks plus fs.promises with async/await for file operations.
